projects_core.name: projects_core
projects_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS unics_id,
  p.title AS title,
  p.total_cost AS total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution AS ec_max_contribution,
  p.start_date AS start_date,
  p.end_date AS end_date,
  p.start_year AS start_year,
  p.end_year AS end_year,
  p.acronym AS acronym,
  p.ec_fund_scheme AS ec_fund_scheme,
  p.framework_program AS framework_program
FROM
  projects p
projects_core.description: Normalized project-level attributes and canonical numeric measures for each project.
validated_on: Show me the acronyms of projects that started in 2018
Find the acronym of projects which have total costs between 100000 and 200000
Show the title of projects with costs higher than 1000000

project_with_programmes_and_subjects.name: project_with_programmes_and_subjects
project_with_programmes_and_subjects.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project,
  pp.programme AS programme,
  psa.subject_area AS subject_area,
  pt.topic AS topic,
  pep.panel AS panel
FROM projects_core p
-- Left join to project_programmes: a project may have zero or more programmes
LEFT JOIN project_programmes pp ON pp.project = p.unics_id
-- Left join to project_subject_areas: a project may have zero or more subject areas
LEFT JOIN project_subject_areas psa ON psa.project = p.unics_id
-- Left join to project_topics: a project may have zero or more topics
LEFT JOIN project_topics pt ON pt.project = p.unics_id
-- Left join to project_erc_panels: ERC panel info (zero or one per project)
LEFT JOIN project_erc_panels pep ON pep.project = p.unics_id
project_with_programmes_and_subjects.description: Denormalized mapping of projects to their associated programmes, subject areas, topics, and ERC panel info (one row per project x programme x subject_area x topic). Useful for filters and grouping by programme/subject/topic.

project_participants.name: project_participants
project_participants.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id,
  pm.project,
  pm.member_name,
  pm.institution_id,
  pm.ec_contribution,
  pm.country,
  pm.member_role
FROM project_members pm
project_participants.description: Project participants / members with their institution linkage and financial contribution per member (one row per project member).

projects_title_lookup_norm.name: projects_title_lookup_norm
projects_title_lookup_norm.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  -- Lifted literals: trimming whitespace and normalizing internal whitespace to single spaces,
  -- then lower-casing for case-insensitive matching.
  -- Uses regexp_replace to collapse any sequence of whitespace into a single space.
  lower(regexp_replace(trim(p.title), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) AS title_normalized
FROM
  projects_core p
projects_title_lookup_norm.description: Normalized/cleaned project title and identifiers to support case-insensitive matching and trimming for user-supplied title filters.

project_financials_by_project.name: project_financials_by_project
project_financials_by_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  pc.unics_id,
  pc.total_cost,
  pc.ec_max_contribution
FROM
  projects_core pc
project_financials_by_project.description: Project-level financial measures (raw, not aggregated across projects) prepared for rollups; one row per project with total_cost and ec_max_contribution.

project_members_by_project.name: project_members_by_project
project_members_by_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.project AS project,
  pm.unics_id AS unics_id,
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.ec_contribution AS ec_contribution,
  pm.country AS country,
  pm.member_role AS member_role
FROM
  project_members pm
project_members_by_project.description: Members associated with each project, exposing member-level financial contribution and institution linkage; one row per project member.

projects_core_6.name: projects_core_6
projects_core_6.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id::integer AS unics_id,
  p.acronym AS acronym,
  (CASE WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN p.start_date::date ELSE NULL END) AS start_date,
  (CASE
     WHEN p.start_year IS NOT NULL THEN p.start_year::integer
     WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(year FROM p.start_date::date)::integer
     ELSE NULL
   END) AS start_year,
  (CASE WHEN p.end_date IS NOT NULL THEN p.end_date::date ELSE NULL END) AS end_date,
  p.ec_call AS ec_call,
  p.framework_program AS framework_program,
  p.ec_fund_scheme AS ec_fund_scheme,
  p.title AS title
FROM projects p
projects_core_6.description: Canonical normalized project-level row with key identifiers, dates, acronym and finance fields. Clean/cast date and year fields for consistent downstream filtering.

project_dates_cohort.name: project_dates_cohort
project_dates_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.start_date,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_date
FROM
  projects p
project_dates_cohort.description: Cohort of projects filtered by a date-based predicate. Exposes project id, acronym and date fields to support flexible time-window filters (year, explicit range). Do not bake specific years into the view; question-specific year/range goes into question_ops.

project_with_participants.name: project_with_participants
project_with_participants.body_sql:
SELECT
  pp.project                       AS project,
  p.unics_id                       AS project_unics_id,
  p.acronym                        AS acronym,
  pm.unics_id                      AS member_unics_id,
  pm.member_name                   AS member_name,
  pm.institution_id                AS institution_id,
  pm.country                       AS country,
  pm.member_role                   AS member_role,
  pm.ec_contribution               AS ec_contribution
FROM
  projects p
JOIN
  project_members pm
  ON p.unics_id = pm.project
LEFT JOIN
  project_participants pp
  ON pp.project = p.unics_id
project_with_participants.description: Denormalized view joining projects with their members/institutions to support filters or groupings by participant attributes (e.g., country, institution, member_role) while keeping per-project granularity. One row per project-member relationship.

projects_core_9.name: projects_core_9
projects_core_9.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  -- canonical integer year columns: prefer explicit start_year/end_year if present,
  -- otherwise derive from dates (extract year). Lift literals: none.
  COALESCE(p.start_year, CASE WHEN p.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date)::integer END) AS start_year,
  COALESCE(p.end_year,   CASE WHEN p.end_date   IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.end_date)::integer   END) AS end_year,
  p.ec_call,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  p.framework_program,
  p.principal_investigator,
  p.acronym
FROM projects p
projects_core_9.description: One row per project with canonical project fields and cleaned date/year columns for filtering and joins. Useful as the basic project entity for many queries (cohorting by dates, title lookup, joins to members/programmes/topics).
validated_on: Find the name of principal investigators in projects that started in 2014
Show the full name of people being investigators in projects that began in 2014
Show the acronym and subject area description of projects with subject area “Mathematics and Statistics”

project_members_denorm.name: project_members_denorm

project_programme_link.name: project_programme_link
project_programme_link.body_sql:

projects_by_year_cohort.name: projects_by_year_cohort
projects_by_year_cohort.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,

  p.start_date,

projects_by_year_cohort.description: Filtered cohort view of projects having a non-null start_date, exposing project id, title and start_date to support year-based cohorts and time filters. Do not bake a specific year into the view; year-specific restrictions belong to question_ops.

institutions_base.name: institutions_base
institutions_base.body_sql:
SELECT
  i.unics_id AS unics_id,
  -- canonicalize institution name: NULL if empty after trim, else trimmed
  NULLIF(btrim(i.institutions_name), '') AS institutions_name,
  -- acronym and short_name normalized similarly
  NULLIF(btrim(i.acronym), '') AS acronym,
  NULLIF(btrim(i.short_name), '') AS short_name,
  -- carry through country_id and geocode regions
  i.country_id AS country_id,
  NULLIF(btrim(i.geocode_regions_3), '') AS geocode_regions_3,
  -- websites and external identifiers normalized (trimmed, empty -> NULL)
  NULLIF(btrim(i.website), '') AS website,
  NULLIF(btrim(i.db_pedia_url), '') AS db_pedia_url,
  NULLIF(btrim(i.wikidata_url), '') AS wikidata_url,
  NULLIF(btrim(i.grid_id), '') AS grid_id
FROM
  institutions i
institutions_base.description: One row per institution with canonicalized textual name fields and key identification columns exposed for filtering and joining. Normalizes NULLs and trims key text columns.
validated_on: Show the name of institutions based in Nordjylland
Show me the all different names of people
counter_examples: Show names of institutions from France or Germany
Show names of institutions which are not from France
Show me the country name of all institutes.

institution_with_country.name: institution_with_country
institution_with_country.body_sql:
SELECT
  i.unics_id AS unics_id,
  i.institutions_name AS institutions_name,
  i.acronym AS acronym,
  i.short_name AS short_name,
  c.unics_id AS country_id,
  i.geocode_regions_3 AS geocode_regions_3,
  i.website AS website,
  i.db_pedia_url AS db_pedia_url,
  i.wikidata_url AS wikidata_url,
  i.grid_id AS grid_id,
  c.country_name AS country_name,
  c.country_code2 AS country_code2,
  c.country_code3 AS country_code3,
  c.geocode_country_code AS geocode_country_code
FROM institutions i
LEFT JOIN countries c
  ON i.country_id = c.unics_id
institution_with_country.description: Denormalized view that joins institutions to their country row, exposing institution and country display fields. One row per institution with country metadata to allow geographic filtering by country-level attributes.

eu_territorial_units_lookup.name: eu_territorial_units_lookup
eu_territorial_units_lookup.body_sql:
SELECT
  etu.description,
  etu.geocode_regions,
  etu.geocode_level,
  etu.nuts_version
FROM
  eu_territorial_units etu
WHERE
  etu.geocode_level = (
    -- lift the desired smallest geocode level out as a literal:
    3
  )
ORDER BY
  etu.description NULLS LAST,
  etu.geocode_regions
eu_territorial_units_lookup.description: Lookup of EU territorial units at the smallest geocode granularity available, exposing geocode_regions and human-readable description and level for filtering by region name.

project_principal_investigators.name: project_principal_investigators
project_principal_investigators.body_sql:

subject_areas_canonical.name: subject_areas_canonical
subject_areas_canonical.body_sql:
SELECT

  trim(lower(sa.title)) AS title,
  trim(lower(coalesce(sa.description, ''))) AS description
FROM subject_areas sa
subject_areas_canonical.description: Canonical subject area rows exposing code and normalized title/description for reliable matching and joins.

projects_with_members_join.name: projects_with_members_join
projects_with_members_join.body_sql:
SELECT

project_membership_core.body_sql:

projects_row_level_34.name: projects_row_level_34
projects_row_level_34.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p.title), ''), pt.title) AS title,
  -- Normalize total_cost: ensure non-negative number; treat NULL as 0 for downstream aggregates
  COALESCE(NULLIF(p.total_cost, 'NaN'::double precision), pf.total_cost, 0.0) * 1.0 AS total_cost
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN projects_title_lookup_norm pt
  ON p.unics_id = pt.unics_id
LEFT JOIN project_financials_by_project pf
  ON p.unics_id = pf.unics_id
projects_row_level_34.description: Cleaned, project-level rows exposing project identifiers and numeric financial measures. Keeps one row per project from the projects table and normalizes numeric columns for downstream aggregation or filtering.

project_member_row_level.name: project_member_row_level
project_member_row_level.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id,
  pm.project,
  pm.member_name,
  pm.member_role,
  pm.institution_id,

project_member_row_level.description: One row per project member with member identity, role, institution link and the project id they belong to. Keeps member-level attributes raw for filtering or joining to project-level data.

project_with_members_denorm.name: project_with_members_denorm
project_with_members_denorm.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS "project_members.unics_id",
  pm.project AS "project_members.project",
  pm.member_name AS "project_members.member_name",
  pm.member_role AS "project_members.member_role",
  pm.institution_id AS "project_members.institution_id",
  p.total_cost AS "projects.total_cost",
  p.acronym AS "projects.acronym",
  p.title AS "projects.title",
  p.start_year AS "projects.start_year",
  p.end_year AS "projects.end_year"
FROM project_members pm
LEFT JOIN projects p
  ON pm.project = p.unics_id
project_with_members_denorm.description: Denormalized row-level view: one row per project member enriched with their project's basic project measures (total_cost etc.) allowing filters comparing member's project to project aggregates.

project_members_row_level_37.name: project_members_row_level_37
project_members_row_level_37.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS unics_id,
  pm.project AS project,
  coalesce(nullif(pm.member_name, ''), nullif(p.member_name, '')) AS member_name,
  coalesce(pm.institution_id, p.institution_id) AS institution_id,
  coalesce(nullif(pm.activity_type, ''), nullif(at.code, '')) AS activity_type,
  coalesce(nullif(pm.country, ''), nullif(c.country_name, '')) AS country,
  coalesce(pm.ec_contribution, p.ec_contribution) AS ec_contribution,
  coalesce(nullif(pm.member_role, ''), nullif(r.code, '')) AS member_role,
  pm.latitude AS latitude,
  pm.longitude AS longitude,
  pm.geocode_regions_3 AS geocode_regions_3
FROM
  project_members pm
LEFT JOIN
  project_members_by_project p
    ON pm.unics_id = p.unics_id
LEFT JOIN
  activity_types at
    ON pm.activity_type = at.code
LEFT JOIN
  countries c
    ON pm.country::text = c.country_name
LEFT JOIN
  project_member_roles r
    ON pm.member_role = r.code
project_members_row_level_37.description: Row-level cleaned cohort of project_members rows. Exposes each project-member association and key attributes for filtering, grouping and joins.

project_member_counts_by_project.name: project_member_counts_by_project
project_member_counts_by_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.project AS project,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE pm.project IS NOT NULL) AS member_count
FROM
  project_members pm
GROUP BY
  pm.project
project_member_counts_by_project.description: Count of project_members rows per project (only counting rows with a non-null project). Useful for threshold and ranking queries about project size/participation.

projects_rowlevel.name: projects_rowlevel
projects_rowlevel.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year
FROM projects_core p
projects_rowlevel.description: One row per project exposing its primary identifiers and funding scheme; canonicalizes relevant fields for joins and analysis.

funding_schemes_dim.name: funding_schemes_dim
funding_schemes_dim.body_sql:
SELECT
  fs.code AS code,
  fs.title AS title
FROM funding_schemes fs
funding_schemes_dim.description: Catalog of funding schemes with their code and human-readable title for joining to projects.

projects_per_funding_scheme.name: projects_per_funding_scheme
projects_per_funding_scheme.body_sql:
SELECT
  pc.ec_fund_scheme AS ec_fund_scheme,
  COUNT(pc.unics_id) AS project_count
FROM
  projects_core pc
GROUP BY
  pc.ec_fund_scheme
ORDER BY
  project_count DESC
projects_per_funding_scheme.description: Counts of projects grouped by funding scheme code; ready for ranking to find the scheme with most projects.

project_financials_by_project_42.name: project_financials_by_project_42
project_financials_by_project_42.body_sql:
SELECT
  pc.unics_id,
  pc.total_cost,
  pc.ec_max_contribution,
  pc.start_year,
  pc.end_year,
  pc.ec_fund_scheme
FROM
  projects_core pc
project_financials_by_project_42.description: Per-project financial measures (keeps one row per project) — suitable for summing or grouping by project-level keys or time attributes.

projects_row_level_43.name: projects_row_level_43
projects_row_level_43.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  p.start_date,
  p.end_date,
  p.ec_fund_scheme,
  p.framework_program,
  p.total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution
FROM projects_core p
projects_row_level_43.description: Row-level canonical projection of the projects table exposing project identifiers, title and year/date fields and key financial/program fields for downstream filtering and joins.

projects_with_programme_info.name: projects_with_programme_info
projects_with_programme_info.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  pp.programme,
  p.framework_program
FROM projects_core p
LEFT JOIN project_with_programmes_and_subjects pp
  ON pp.project = p.unics_id
projects_with_programme_info.description: Denormalized view joining projects to their programme codes (if any) to expose project->programme relationships alongside project attributes for filtering/grouping.

project_membership_projection.name: project_membership_projection
project_membership_projection.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id,
  pm.project,
  pm.member_name,
  pm.institution_id,
  pm.ec_contribution,
  pm.country,
  pm.member_role
FROM
  project_participants pm
project_membership_projection.description: Row-level projection of project_members exposing member-level financial contribution and institution linkage for filtering or aggregation by project or institution.

projects_duration_years.name: projects_duration_years
projects_duration_years.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  -- literal thresholds/behavior lifted out: none needed here; simple arithmetic
  (p.end_year - p.start_year) AS duration_years
FROM
  projects_core p
projects_duration_years.description: Compute a normalized duration measure (end_year - start_year) per project. Keeps one row per project and preserves raw start/end year integers so callers can apply further filters/aggregations.

projects_duration_rank.name: projects_duration_rank
projects_duration_rank.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.acronym,
  p.title,
  p.start_year,
  p.end_year,
  (p.end_year - p.start_year) AS duration_years,
  dense_rank() OVER (
    ORDER BY (p.end_year - p.start_year) DESC
  ) AS duration_rank
FROM
  projects_core p
WHERE
  p.start_year IS NOT NULL
  AND p.end_year IS NOT NULL
projects_duration_rank.description: Add a windowed rank over projects by duration_years to support selecting top-N or ties. One row per project with duration and its rank (dense_rank) among projects that have non-null start_year and end_year.

projects_topics_link.name: projects_topics_link
projects_topics_link.body_sql:
SELECT
  project_topics.project AS project,
  project_topics.topic AS topic
FROM
  project_topics
projects_topics_link.description: Denormalized link of projects to topics: one row per project-topic association, exposing project id and topic code for queries that need to join projects and topics.

projects_topics_link_49.name: projects_topics_link_49
projects_topics_link_49.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.topic::text AS project,        -- lift any literal casting into the view as needed
  p.topic AS topic,
  t.title AS topic_title
FROM project_topics p
LEFT JOIN topics t
  ON p.topic = t.code
projects_topics_link_49.description: Denormalized link of projects to their topics, exposing project id and topic code/title for queries that join projects and topics (keeps one row per project-topic association).

projects_by_principal_investigator.name: projects_by_principal_investigator
projects_by_principal_investigator.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS unics_id,
  p.acronym AS acronym,
  p.title AS title,
  p.start_date AS start_date,
  p.end_date AS end_date,
  p.start_year AS start_year,
  p.end_year AS end_year,
  p.principal_investigator AS principal_investigator
FROM projects p
projects_by_principal_investigator.description: Project rows with the principal investigator id exposed and project identifiers/details for counting or further filtering by PI.

project_person_membership.name: project_person_membership
project_person_membership.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS unics_id,
  pm.project AS project,
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.country AS country
FROM project_members pm
project_person_membership.description: Denormalized relation of project membership per person (one row per project_members.unics_id + project_members.project). Exposes person id, project id and membership attributes for filtering people by project involvement and roles.

project_financials_by_project_52.name: project_financials_by_project_52
project_financials_by_project_52.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project_unics_id,
  p.total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution
FROM projects_core p
project_financials_by_project_52.description: Aggregated financial measures per project. Produces one row per project containing raw totals and optional derived measures (keeps measures unaggregated apart from grouping by project). Useful for queries that filter or sort by project-level finances.

project_financials.name: project_financials
project_financials.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.total_cost,
  p.ec_max_contribution
FROM
  project_financials_by_project p
project_financials.description: Per-project financial measures (raw sums/amounts) and basic temporal attributes. Aggregated at project granularity to support ranking and monetary filters. Does NOT apply any question-specific thresholds.

project_with_principal_investigator_and_.name: project_with_principal_investigator_and_programme
project_with_principal_investigator_and_.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id,
  p.title,
  p.principal_investigator,
  pe.full_name AS people_full_name,
  pp.programme
FROM
  projects p
LEFT JOIN people pe
  ON p.principal_investigator = pe.unics_id
LEFT JOIN project_programmes pp
  ON p.unics_id = pp.project
project_with_principal_investigator_and_.description: Denormalized view joining projects to their principal investigator (people) and assigned programme code from project_programmes, exposing identifying columns useful for filtering, grouping or display.

project_financials_by_project_55.name: project_financials_by_project_55
project_financials_by_project_55.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS unics_id,
  COALESCE(p.total_cost, 0.0) AS total_cost,
  COALESCE(p.ec_max_contribution, 0.0) AS ec_max_contribution
FROM
  projects_core p
project_financials_by_project_55.description: Per-project financial measures (raw sums and primary cost columns). Aggregates at project level to ensure a stable numeric measure exposure for ranking/filters. This view intentionally groups at project id so downstream queries can apply thresholds or compute ratios.

project_with_primary_people.name: project_with_primary_people
project_with_primary_people.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS unics_id,
  p.title AS title,
  p.total_cost AS total_cost,
  p.principal_investigator AS principal_investigator,
  pe.full_name AS pi_full_name
FROM projects p
LEFT JOIN people pe
  ON p.principal_investigator = pe.unics_id
project_with_primary_people.description: Denormalized project row joined to its principal investigator's basic person info. Useful when questions ask for project attributes alongside PI name.

project_members_row_level_57.name: project_members_row_level_57
project_members_row_level_57.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS project,                            -- project id (from project_members.unics_id: the project the member belongs to)
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.institution_id AS institution_id,
  pm.ec_contribution AS ec_contribution,
  pm.country AS country,
  pm.member_short_name AS member_short_name,
  pm.unics_id AS project_member_id                  -- row-level id / grain carrier (unics_id from project_members table)
FROM
  project_members pm
project_members_row_level_57.description: Row-level project member records (one row per project member). Exposes member identity, role, linked project id and institution and basic location/contribution fields so callers can filter or join for questions about members of projects.

projects_with_members_denormalized.name: projects_with_members_denormalized
projects_with_members_denormalized.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id AS project_unics_id,
  p.title AS project_title,
  pm.unics_id AS member_unics_id,
  pm.member_name AS member_name,
  pm.member_role AS member_role,
  pm.ec_contribution AS ec_contribution,
  pm.country AS member_country
FROM project_participants pm
JOIN projects_core p
  ON pm.project = p.unics_id
projects_with_members_denormalized.description: Denormalized rows combining projects and their project_members (one row per project member linked to its project). Useful for queries that need project attributes alongside member attributes without repeated joins.

erc_research_domains_core.name: erc_research_domains_core
erc_research_domains_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  trim(lower(code)) AS code,
  nullif(trim(both ' ' FROM description), '') AS description
FROM erc_research_domains
ORDER BY trim(lower(code))
erc_research_domains_core.description: Canonical list of ERC research domains with cleaned code and description. One row per ERC research domain as recorded in the source table.

institutions_with_country_60.name: institutions_with_country_60
institutions_with_country_60.body_sql:
SELECT
  i.unics_id,
  i.institutions_name,
  c.country_name,
  c.unics_id AS country_id
FROM institutions i
LEFT JOIN countries c
  ON i.country_id = c.unics_id
institutions_with_country_60.description: Denormalized view joining institutions to countries to expose institution rows with resolved country_name when available. Left join semantics so institutions without a matching country remain present with NULL country_name.

institutions_with_country_61.name: institutions_with_country_61
institutions_with_country_61.body_sql:
SELECT
  i.unics_id,
  i.institutions_name,
  i.country_id,
  c.country_name
FROM institutions i
LEFT JOIN countries c
  ON i.country_id = c.unics_id
institutions_with_country_61.description: Denormalized view joining institutions to countries to expose the institution's country name when available. Keeps all institutions (left join), so institutions with missing or unmatched country_id are still present with NULL country_name.

countries_core_62.name: countries_core_62
countries_core_62.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.country_code2,
  c.country_code3,
  c.country_name,
  c.unics_id,
  c.geocode_country_code
FROM countries c
countries_core_62.description: One-row-per-country baseline with canonical country identifiers and names; used as the primary country cohort for lookups, filters and joins.

countries_canonical_codes.name: countries_canonical_codes
countries_canonical_codes.body_sql:
SELECT
  -- canonical 2-char code: trim, upper, blank -> NULL
  NULLIF(nullif(trim(upper(country_code2)), ''), '') AS country_code2,
  -- canonical 3-char code: trim, upper, blank -> NULL
  NULLIF(nullif(trim(upper(country_code3)), ''), '') AS country_code3,
  -- keep country name as-is (trimmed)
  NULLIF(trim(country_name), '') AS country_name,
  unics_id
FROM countries
countries_canonical_codes.description: Normalized projection of countries ensuring codes are trimmed/upper-cased and null-cleaned for consistent two- and three-character codes.

funding_schemes_core.name: funding_schemes_core
funding_schemes_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  fs.code AS code,
  fs.title AS title
FROM
  funding_schemes fs
funding_schemes_core.description: One row per funding scheme with its canonical code and title; useful as the base cohort for lookups and filters on funding scheme title or code.

programmes_base.name: programmes_base
programmes_base.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.code AS code,
  p.title AS title,
  p.rcn AS rcn,
  p.short_name AS short_name,
  p.parent AS parent
FROM
  programmes p
programmes_base.description: Canonical cleaned projection of programmes: one row per programme with primary identifying columns and common attributes (title, short_name, code, rcn, parent). Useful as the base relation for lookups, filters by short_name, joins to projects, and for downstream aggregations.

project_programme_mapping.name: project_programme_mapping
project_programme_mapping.body_sql:
SELECT
  ppp.project AS project,
  ppp.programme AS programme
FROM project_with_programmes_and_subjects ppp
project_programme_mapping.description: Denormalized mapping of projects to their programmes. One row per project-programme association, exposing project id and programme code to enable queries that join projects and programmes, filter by programme short_name/title, and aggregate projects per programme.

programme_project_summary.name: programme_project_summary
programme_project_summary.body_sql:
SELECT
  pp.programme AS programme,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pp.project) AS project_count,
  MIN(p.start_year) AS min_start_year,
  MAX(p.end_year) AS max_end_year
FROM
  project_with_programmes_and_subjects pp
LEFT JOIN
  projects_core p
  ON pp.project = p.unics_id
GROUP BY
  pp.programme
programme_project_summary.description: Aggregated measures per programme: counts of associated projects and basic min/max years from linked projects. Grain is programme code. Useful for questions about programme-level metrics (number of projects, active years) while keeping programme as the grouping key.

project_members_core.name: project_members_core
project_members_core.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS "project_members.unics_id",
  pm.project AS "project_members.project",
  pm.member_name AS "project_members.member_name",
  pm.member_role AS "project_members.member_role",
  pm.institution_id AS "project_members.institution_id",
  pm.country AS "project_members.country",
  pm.ec_contribution AS "project_members.ec_contribution",
  pm.member_short_name AS "project_members.member_short_name"
FROM project_members pm
project_members_core.description: Row-level core project membership records (one row per project_members.unics_id) with key membership fields and raw location/finance attributes. Useful as the base cohort for queries about members of projects, filtering by project, country, role, or institution.

projects_core_69.name: projects_core_69
projects_core_69.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.unics_id                                    AS "projects.unics_id",
  p.acronym                                     AS "projects.acronym",
  p.title                                       AS "projects.title",
  p.start_date                                  AS "projects.start_date",
  p.end_date                                    AS "projects.end_date",
  p.framework_program                           AS "projects.framework_program",
  p.ec_fund_scheme                              AS "projects.ec_fund_scheme",
  p.principal_investigator                      AS "projects.principal_investigator"
FROM
  projects p
projects_core_69.description: Row-level projects metadata (one row per projects.unics_id) exposing identifiers, acronym, title, start/end dates and funding scheme. Use to join/filter projects by acronym, year, framework, or principal investigator.

project_member_with_project.name: project_member_with_project
project_member_with_project.body_sql:
SELECT
  pm.unics_id AS "project_members.unics_id",
  pm.member_name AS "project_members.member_name",
  pm.member_role AS "project_members.member_role",
  pm.project AS "project_members.project",
  p.unics_id AS "projects.unics_id",
  p.acronym AS "projects.acronym"
FROM project_members pm
LEFT JOIN projects p
  ON pm.project = p.unics_id
project_member_with_project.description: Denormalized rows combining project_members with their project row (one row per project_members.unics_id). Exposes member details along with project identifiers (project unics_id and acronym) to simplify queries that select members by project attributes.
